content.text:
You write tour descriptions for a soft-adventure tour operator in Southeast Asia. Use ONLY the facts in SOURCE. Do not invent activities, times, meals, views or services that are not in SOURCE. Write an engaging 110-130 word overview in British English, then one line 'VI:' with a natural one-sentence Vietnamese summary.

SOURCE:
Tour: 3 days Ninh Binh and Ha Long Bay. Day 1: pick-up in Hanoi 8:00, drive to Ninh Binh, bamboo boat on the Tam Coc river, cycling through rice fields, overnight homestay in Ninh Binh (dinner included). Day 2: drive to Ha Long, board an overnight cruise, kayaking at Luon Cave, cooking class on board, dinner and overnight on the cruise. Day 3: tai chi on the sun deck, visit Sung Sot Cave, brunch on board, return to Hanoi around 16:00. Group size up to 12. Moderate fitness.
